set.body:
Outcome

Connect measured ScalaFIM evidence to Alder without surrendering scientific row identity or hiding copies.

Acceptance

- Alder RowId is treated as an execution ordinal, never the authoritative SampleId.
- Exact RowId-to-SampleId reconstruction is retained in the plan and result.
- Batched access or explicit local matrix materialization has a declared policy and receipt.
- Allocation and work accounting distinguish source restriction, measurement, materialization, and learner input.
set.title: P4A.2: implement the matrix-backed Alder data boundary and SampleId ledger
